verdict.rationale: SigNoz has a public pricing page that advertises unlimited teammates and any number of hosts, and its llms.txt describes SigNoz Cloud as usage-based. This suggests self-serve, published pricing rather than a sales-gated quote. However, the pack contains no actual per-signal rates, so predicting costs from published numbers is only implied. missing for 10: published per-signal rates (per GB of logs/traces, per million metric samples), any pricing calculator or worked cost example, explicit no-sales-contact self-serve signup, and independent corroboration that costs are predictable.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: SigNoz Cloud brings your traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform. Simple usage-base
